test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
A hemispherical bowl is made of steel whose thickness is 2 cm. The inside radius of the bowl is 3 cm. Find the volume (in cm³) of the steel used in making the bowl. (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)

(Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Inside radius of the bowl (r) = 3 cm.

Thickness of the steel (t) = 2 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a hemisphere = (2)/(3) pi r³ 

Volume of steel used = Volume of outer hemisphere - Volume of inner hemisphere

**Calculation:**

Outer radius of the bowl (R) = Inside radius + Thickness = 3 cm + 2 cm = 5 cm

Volume of outer hemisphere = (2)/(3) pi R³ 

Volume of outer hemisphere = (2)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 5³ 

Volume of outer hemisphere = (2)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 125 

Volume of outer hemisphere = (2 times 22 times 125)/(3 times 7) 

Volume of outer hemisphere = (5500)/(21) 

Volume of outer hemisphere ≈ 261.90 cm³

Volume of inner hemisphere = (2)/(3) pi r³ 

Volume of inner hemisphere = (2)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 3³ 

Volume of inner hemisphere = (2)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 27 

Volume of inner hemisphere = (2 times 22 times 27)/(3 times 7) 

Volume of inner hemisphere = (1188)/(21) 

Volume of inner hemisphere ≈ 56.57 cm³

Volume of steel used = Volume of outer hemisphere - Volume of inner hemisphere

Volume of steel used ≈ 261.90 cm³ - 56.57 cm³

Volume of steel used ≈ 205.33 cm³

**The volume of the steel used in making the bowl is 205.33 cm³.**
